semantic_identity: One source-owned governance concept or rule is identified by its owner-qualified semantic id and version, not by repository or package bytes.
instance_registration_role: Invariant and rule registration IDs identify candidate ontology records. Canonical selectors, source status, import hashes, and package digests do not supply a missing source-owned semantic version and do not evidence adoption.
source_digest_role: Import SHA-256 values preserve provenance for the exact snapshots used to materialize this package. Live currentness is checked only for selected records and selectors; whole-file drift is not a lifecycle signal.
package_digest_role: A package digest identifies one validation snapshot only; it is never semantic identity, lifecycle state, adoption, authority, or enforcement evidence.
product_binding_role: Product bindings validate only selected target node identities and postures. Unrelated product-node changes do not invalidate a binding.
currentness_behavior: A changed source or selected target may make the affected reference non-current. It does not rewrite history, reopen a lifecycle, or create a new rule version by itself.
